contract: Field bosses (Config.FieldBosses; the King Slime A23-84/85, king_slime_split §3): one of each on the server, first slot FirstDelay s after start, then every Interval s from its last appearance, a due slot waits for a ready hunter in its zone, stays Lifetime s; spot Attr on workspace.Map > (Hill) HillTop + 8 toward HillPathFoot (flat) > Spawn > a zone spawn point, Radius; no ground = retry in RetryDelay s; defeat = Fx KingDefeat { Key, Kind, Pos, Contributors (numbers) } to all + <Key>Defeat + Defeated(key, kind, ids, rec); time up / lost model = RemoveEvent(fade, leaving) + <Key>Leave; GameState <Key>Active / EndsAt / NextAt. King Slime: 180 / 480 / 300 s, KingSpawn, hill. BigSlime = Slime Prince; the card is SlimeKing's. A23-113 ⑦ crowd HP (+ 검수 bosshp_verify fixes): def HP = one hunter about 2 min (King 2600 Lv 5-8 T2, Clatter 20000 Lv25 T4, by the solo DPS model on the current Config); every 0.5 s hunters = the shares added up (in tenths, 1..10) of the ready, alive players within 50 studs: own damage over the last 15 s / one hunter's pace (def HP / 120 s) over the time since its first hit in the window (at least Rise 2 s: comes fast, fades slow, no on / off gain), at most 1 (ByDamage = false: 1 each); MaxHP = def HP x (1 + 0.5 x (hunters - 1)), the HP fraction kept (MonsterService.SetEventMaxHP: event monsters only, rounded, never below 1 HP; DamageTotals = a copy); a boss's own Crowd wins, false = off. The reward bar and the side share read each hit as a share of the MaxHP it had then (MonsterService _share; no _share = damage / MaxHP). The retry King's cap is Retry.MaxHP (2500).
limitations: MonsterService (SpawnEvent ground pick, kill payout, model borrow), PlayerService, ZoneService and AnnounceService are doubles; the client (boss chip, minimap icon) and the shrine placement are not here. The solo DPS model is an average (75% uptime, no perks / enhancement / pets); real fight times need play.
